svg.title: TypeScript participation exceeded Java in all 93 economies
svg.desc: Each dot is one of the same 93 economies. A ratio above 1 means more contributors pushed to repositories containing TypeScript than Java. The axis is logarithmic. A person may count toward both languages; this does not measure code volume or switching.
svg.metadata: Data: GitHub Innovation Graph (CC0), https://github.com/github/innovationgraph/tree/078fb62ee4395d321bec9f4f06694cca68f6b6cb/data. Maps: Natural Earth (public domain); DataMeet India, CC BY 4.0, adapted. Full linked attribution accompanies each map in the gallery and notes.
